1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Had Laju (Lebuh Raya

Penyuraian Timur (EDL)) 2014.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Ogos 2014.

Larangan

2. (1) Pemanduan suatu kenderaan motor dengan kelajuan yang melebihi had

laju yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2) Jadual Pertama di atas jalan yang dinyatakan

dalam ruang (1) dilarang.

(2) Jalan dengan had laju yang dinyatakan di bawah subperenggan (1)

ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual Kedua.

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

SPEED LIMIT (EASTERN DISPERSAL LINK EXPRESSWAY (EDL)) ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(2) of the Road Transport Act 1987

[Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Speed Limit (Eastern Dispersal Link

Expressway (EDL)) Order 2014.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 August 2014.

Prohibition

2. (1) The driving of a motor vehicle at a speed exceeding the speed limit as

specified in column (2) of the First Schedule on the road specified in column (1) is

prohibited.

(2) The road with speed limit as specified in subparagraph (1) is shown on

the map in the Second Schedule.

 FIRST SCHEDULE

(1)

Road

(2)

Speed limit

(km/h)

1. The part of the road known as the Eastern Dispersal Link

Expressway (EDL) commencing from coordinates N 162386.856,

E 641445.071 of the Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric

(GDM2000) Grid and ending at the Customs, Immigration and

Quarantine Complex (CIQ) which is known as the Bangunan Sultan

Iskandar at coordinates N 162096.730, E 641326.793 of the RSO

Geocentric (GDM2000) Grid.

2. The part of the road known as the Eastern Dispersal Link

Expressway (EDL) commencing from coordinates N 162096.730,

E 641326.793 of the RSO Geocentric (GDM2000) Grid and ending at

coordinates N 161918.328, E 640983.311 of the RSO Geocentric

(GDM2000) Grid in the Customs, Immigration and Quarantine

Complex (CIQ) which is known as the Bangunan Sultan Iskandar.
